title: Approver Access Request — payload
description: One party asks a contact — over an already-established VRC relationship — for access to a named resource. The counterparty approves or denies; either way a signed #response travels back, never a silent drop.

resource.description: Human-readable description of what access is being requested, shown to the approving person verbatim.

resourceId.description: Opaque identifier for the resource in a real integration's own access-control system.

reason.description: Why the requester is asking, in their own words. A hint reaching a human, not an obligation the counterparty must honour.
